lesson.subtitle: Lesson 13 -- What Is It Like? Describing and Evaluating with Adjectives
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 13 -- What Is It Like?

listenings.text: Hello, and thank you for the evaluation of the platform. Here is a short summary of the answers. The teachers say the platform is very useful, and the first screen is clear. But the report page is difficult: many teachers do not find it. The videos are simple and short, and that is really good. One teacher wrote: it is a powerful tool, but it is not easy on a small phone. Please read the full document before the meeting. Thank you very much.

Hi, this is a message about your session at the November event. The room is small, and that is good for you: it is really quiet. The screen is very big, so your slides do not need much text. The internet in the building is not always clear, so please bring your presentation in a file too. Your session is important for the program, and everybody wants to hear about the public schools. See you in November.

extra_audio.text: Joice opens the new platform on her computer. She looks at the first screen and finds it clear. She tries the report page and finds it difficult. She writes three words about the platform: useful, simple, powerful. She sends her evaluation to the team.
